status: TASK-208 both-game test build (plain, no PGO); distribution private/slice418-dist-130-rc16 (gt4-spec2.exe); not a published release

ee_library.generated_units: the TASK-166 Spec II aspect units (private/slice405-spec2-aspect-producer: the pinned Spec II translation with unit_0031 and unit_003A patched) with the rc14 hook sites added by scripts/camera360_units.py
ee_library.recipe: scripts/coregs2_bench/game/ee_configure.cmd and ee_build.cmd (plain: clang-cl 22.1.3, SSE4.1, the derived headers of scripts/prepare_fast_headers.py, no profile)

gpu_renderer: CoreGS 2.0 (GT4_RENDERER=hw, GT4_HW_CORE=2), built in; gt4-gs is not part of this CoreGS 2.0 test build
release_distribution: GT4_RELEASE_DISTRIBUTION=ON: the executable loads the nine compute shaders from <executable folder>\shaders and fails with a clear message when the folder is missing
shader_cache: GT4_HW_SHADER_CACHE is set by the launcher (data\shader-cache); the launcher's --prepare-shaders --prepare-scale N compiles the shipped corpus and the recorded keys expanded over the session's CoreGS 2.0 scale (TASK-206), and a session whose scale does not match the stamp compiles nothing and records (TASK-204)

toolchain.build: CMake/Ninja VS2022 x64 ABI Windows SDK

build_recipe: private/slice418-tools/configure-spec2.cmd (the rc15 Spec II recipe: -DGT4_TARGET=spec2, -DGT4_EE_PROFILE=spec2, -DGT4_EE_LIBRARY=<slice407 aspect-hooked library> with its SHA-256, the slice276 IOP runtime, the Spec II VU0 tables, -DGT4_RELEASE_DISTRIBUTION=ON, no PGO, no ThinLTO) and private/slice418-tools/build-spec2.cmd.

owner_launch.direct: gt4.exe <reconstructed ELF> --ntsc --disc "<v2.00 ISO>" --memcard <copy>.ps2 (CoreGS 2.0, GT4_HW_SHADER_CACHE required for the TASK-204/TASK-206 behaviour); gt4-spec2.exe with the Spec II derived ELF and its disc for the second game

limits: No in-game play test yet: the owner tests this build in game (both games); the packaging step builds the installer and the portable zip.

The list is the TASK-205 mapping (644 keys, 100 new, 204 signatures) expanded at prepare time over the session's render scale (TASK-206); the 4x gate and a four-track 1x spot check are the headless evidence.
The kit carries no gt4-gs package: this is a CoreGS 2.0 build and the launcher downloads gt4-gs into its data folder when the PCSX2 GS renderer is selected (decision 0070).
The prepare is mandatory for specialised pipelines: a failed or skipped prepare leaves every variant on the uber pipeline (same pixels, more fragment cost) until the next Play's prepare.

A cache prepared for another render scale is refused on purpose (the scale is in the stamp): after changing the Render scale the first session draws with uber and records, and the next Play prepares at the new scale.

A quarantined variant stays on the uber pipeline on this card and driver (its pixels are the same); the way back is deleting the shader cache folder's quarantine.bin (the launcher's support log lists it).
